contracts: unauthenticated requests do not consume the failure budget
repeated requests with the same wrong Authorization value count once per window
three distinct wrong credentials trigger temporary HTTP 429 in regression configuration
active lockout also blocks a correct PIN
correct authentication recovers automatically after expiry
note: PASS covers this source/runtime security contract only. Real browser, microphone, Android-device and iPhone-device release gates remain separate and are not promoted by this evidence.
